endorsements.name: Joxean Koret
endorsements.label: CVE-2014-125118
endorsements.description: A command injection vulnerability exists in the eScan Web Management Console version 5.5-2. The application fails to properly sanitize the 'pass' parameter when processing login requests to login.php, allowing an authenticated attacker with a valid username to inject arbitrary commands via a specially crafted password value. Successful exploitation results in remote code execution. Privilege escalation to root is possible by abusing the runasroot utility with mwconf-level privileges.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 4.0, 9.4)
